key_insight: G2Rec combines holistic graph-based user co-engagement modeling with semantic tokenization to better capture user interest context for generative recommendation.
engineering_relevance: The framework is designed for industrial-scale sequential recommendation, making it relevant for recommender systems that need scalable, context-rich user modeling.
method: Models distributed user interest context from co-engagement graphs at a holistic level.
Tokenizes item semantics with explicit supervision signals instead of relying on heuristics.
Unifies graph-based context modeling and semantic tokenization into one scalable generative recommendation framework.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports online deployment across product surfaces and extensive experiments on public datasets, with G2Rec outperforming existing methods.
watch_item: Practical performance may depend on the quality and scalability of graph construction and tokenization in very large, evolving catalogs.
paper_title: Structuring and Tokenizing Distributed User Interest Context for Generative Recommendation
